dex.text: Hangs from the cave roof as a single cold drop with a pointed hat, waiting for the right moment to let go. The right moment is usually the back of your neck.
dex.fact: Stalactites grow as dripping water leaves behind a thin film of calcite, so slowly that a long one can take many thousands of years; the oils from a single touch can stop one growing.

dex.text: A pale ghost of flowstone that drifts through the deep chambers, humming to the dripping water. It has been growing for ten thousand years and would like you to stop shining that lamp in its face.
dex.fact: The Marble Arch Caves under Cuilcagh mountain are a show cave in a UNESCO Global Geopark, and tours begin with a boat ride along an underground river.
